runs.brief: Fake-door landing page for a SolidWorks <-> Fusion feature-history translation bureau. Two equal direction doors, counted separately; disclosure plate before the card field at price type size; Stripe setup intent reservation.
runs.plate: disclosure band, full-bleed signal yellow, ink type at --fs-price
runs.notes: First Hallmark run for this project, so no rotation constraint applied. Grid chosen over a card-based theme because the exposed 12-column hairline rails read as drawing paper for a CAD audience; yellow over ultramarine to carry the McMaster tone reference and avoid default-AI blue.
